FN-W1N4C55-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 178
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: «Released Date»
House Bill 178 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of certain city boards of
education that elect to form a consolidated school, as provided by this bill, dependent on the
difference in: 1) any costs or savings associated with forming and operating such school, and; 2)
the cost of otherwise operating non-consolidated schools under current law. This bill would also
increase the administrative obligations of the State Board of Education to adopt rules to
implement the provision of this bill.
This bill would not otherwise directly affect state of local funding.

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 178
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/21/2026
House Bill 178 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education could increase or
decrease the obligations of certain city boards of education that elect to form a consolidated
school system, as provided by this bill, dependent on the difference in: 1) any costs or savings
associated with consolidating the school systems, and; 2) the cost of otherwise operating
non-consolidated schools systems under current law. This bill would also increase the
administrative obligations of the State Board of Education to adopt rules to implement the
provision of this bill.
This bill would not otherwise directly affect state of local funding.
